name: Spelljammer
description: Spelljammer is a Dungeons & Dragons campaign setting of interplanetary and interplanar seafaring — magically-powered spelljamming ships carry crews between the crystal spheres of Wildspace and beyond, through the Astral Plane's Phlogiston. It reframes the same core D&D rules around ship-to-ship combat, alien crews, and voyages between worlds rather than replacing them with a separate ruleset.
